categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: chemical fibers production, environmental equipment engineering services, and recycled plastic production. The chemical fibers segment focuses on differentiated products such as flame-retardant fibers and composite fibers. The equipment engineering segment designs, manufactures, and installs PET and other plastic recycling systems globally. The recycled plastic segment produces recycled polyester pellets, including food-grade rPET for beverage packaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced PET plastic recycling systems with high-efficiency cleaning, sorting, and pelletizing processes. The company develops proprietary flame-retardant and biodegradable fibers using polymer modification and fiber spinning techniques. Their equipment integrates automation, SCADA control systems, and optical sorting for high throughput and quality. Production methods encompass mechanical recycling, extrusion, solid-state polycondensation, and customized engineering solutions for recycling lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include beverage and food packaging manufacturers requiring food-grade recycled PET, textile and apparel companies using functional and recycled fibers, and industrial clients needing customized recycling equipment. Major markets served are the packaging, textile, automotive, hygiene products, and environmental engineering sectors. The company also targets international brands committed to ESG and sustainable packaging goals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China with significant market presence in India, Southeast Asia, the United States, and Japan. It has subsidiaries and offices in Zhejiang Province, Taiwan, Indonesia, and the United States, supporting global sales and engineering services. The company leverages its strong position in China and Taiwan while expanding aggressively in emerging markets like India.
categories.supply_chain_position: BORETECH operates primarily in the midstream segment of the recycling supply chain, manufacturing recycling equipment and producing recycled polyester fibers and pellets. It integrates upstream raw material sourcing of recycled plastics and downstream supply to fiber manufacturers and packaging producers. The company provides end-to-end solutions including equipment design, manufacturing, installation, and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in differentiated chemical fibers such as flame-retardant, biodegradable, and functional fibers, alongside innovations in recycling equipment automation and efficiency. It focuses on developing food-grade rPET with regulatory certifications and expanding recycling capacity. Future R&D includes multi-channel sorting machines, small-capacity PET washing and pelletizing lines, and advanced fiber technologies to meet evolving market demands and sustainability trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of recycled polyester fibers and pellets, customized recycling equipment and engineering services, and after-sales support including maintenance and consumables. The company also earns income from integrated EPC (engineering, procurement, construction) projects for recycling plants. Its business model combines product sales with engineering service contracts and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with established European recycling equipment suppliers and large chemical fiber producers. It differentiates itself through vertical integration, proprietary technology, and customized engineering solutions. While its chemical fiber segment targets niche differentiated products rather than high-volume market share, its equipment segment holds a leading market share in India and maintains a strong global presence. It is recognized as a leading player in the international plastic recycling and functional fiber industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the group achieved consolidated revenues of approximately NT$5.44 billion, a 22% increase over 2023, with net profit of NT$490 million and EPS of NT$7.51. The company has shown steady growth driven by strong demand for recycled polyester pellets and recycling equipment. It employs over 700 staff and invests over 2% of revenue annually in R&D. The company completed a successful public listing in early 2025, enhancing its capital base for expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BORETECH emphasizes high-quality, certified food-grade recycled PET products and differentiated functional fibers such as flame-retardant and biodegradable types. Its competitive edge lies in integrated recycling solutions combining advanced equipment, engineering services, and downstream fiber production. The company offers customized, energy-efficient, and automated recycling systems tailored to client needs, supporting global sustainability goals and regulatory compliance. Its vertical integration and strong R&D capabilities enable it to deliver superior product quality and innovative solutions.
